name: slow-thinking
description: Slow reasoning, then a slow answer: for opening the reasoning while it streams.
title: Thinking slowly

steps.thinking: First I list what is known. Then I compare the two numbers digit by digit, starting from the tenths. Nine tenths against one tenth: the first is larger, whatever follows.
steps.text: **0.9** is larger than 0.11. Nine tenths beat one tenth, and the hundredths cannot change that.
